reference.pathophysiology: Immune or toxic destruction empties marrow leaving pancytopenia with empty trephine; Fanconi breaks chromosomes with short thumbs and pigment, telomere defects grey nails and lungs, and PNH clones complicate with thrombosis.
additionalDifferentials: Aplastic versus MDS versus leukaemia versus hypersplenism by trephine blasts and spleen
Acquired versus Fanconi versus telomere by breaks and nails
PNH versus pure by flow and urine
